fullDescription: A professional smartphone marketplace and tech review platform design featuring a clean blue-centric color palette, modern typography, and a structured modular layout. Optimized for high-intent consumers looking for specs, price comparisons, and buying guides. Suitable for tech retail, smartphone directories, fintech marketplaces, and electronics review sites. Key visual features include glassmorphism-lite accents, soft drop shadows, multi-colored category grids, and 3D-effect device mockups. The layout follows a classic e-commerce funnel starting with global search, moving to trending discovery, and ending with specialized comparison tools.
prompt:
## Resumo
A pixel-perfect smartphone directory and marketplace landing page with a primary blue #0052CC accent, utilizing a 1440px grid. The design focuses on information density and high readability using the Inter font family, featuring specific sections for brand discovery, budget-based browsing, and interactive phone comparison tools.

## Estilo Visual
### Core Styling Guidelines
- **Typography**: Primary font is 'Inter', sans-serif. Use 5xl (48px) weight 800 for Hero headlines, text-lg (18px) weight 700 for section titles, and text-xs (12px) for secondary metadata.
- **Color Palette**: 
  - Primary Blue: #0052CC
  - Interactive Blue: #2684FF
  - Background Light: #F9FAFB
  - Surface White: #FFFFFF
  - Text Dark: #111827
  - Text Muted: #6B7280
- **Shadows**: Use 0 4px 12px rgba(0,82,204,0.12) for active hover states and 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.05) for default card states.
- **Borders**: 1px solid #F3F4F6 (Gray-100) or #E5E7EB (Gray-200).
- **Animations**: CSS transitions of 0.2s ease-in-out for all hover states. Hover effects must include a subtle lift (translateY(-2px)) and shadow deepening.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header Navigation
Height 56px (h-14). Sticky position. White background with a 1px border-bottom #F3F4F6. Logo on far left: 'Mobile' in #111827 and 'Dokan' in #0052CC. Center navigation links (Phones, Brands, Compare, Reviews, News, Guides) in text-sm font-medium color #374151 with hover color #0052CC. Right side icons for Wishlist (Heart), Notifications (Bell with a red #EF4444 dot), and Profile (User-circle).

### Hero Section
Background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0f4ff 0%, #dbeafe 100%). Content split 50/50. Left side contains 48px headline with blue accent, 14px description, a wide search input with a blue search button (#0052CC), and a row of rounded filter chips. Right side features two overlapping smartphone mockups (one white, one purple) with floating data badges for '2024 Release', '৳ 14,999 Price', and 'DXOMARK Score 95'.

### Trending Phones Carousel
Title 18px font-bold with a 'View All' blue link with a right arrow icon. Carousel items are 6-column grid cards. Each card has a 112px height image container with a subtle gray gradient background, phone model name in 14px bold, brand in 10px gray, and price in #0052CC. Include a heart icon in the top right of the card and a 5-star rating row.

### Budget & Brand Grid
Two-column layout. Left column: 'Shop By Brand' 6x3 grid of 100px wide cards containing high-res brand logos and names. Right column: 'Browse by Budget' 4x2 grid of color-coded cards (Red-50, Blue-50, Green-50 backgrounds) with specific price ranges (Under 10k, 10k-20k, etc.) and category icons.

### Compare Tool Card
Full-width section with a #F9FAFB background. Features a 'Start Comparing' card with two empty smartphone selection slots (Select Phone A / Select Phone B) separated by a blue 'VS' circle. Below the selection slots, display an 8-item icon grid for comparison criteria (Display, CPU, RAM, etc.) in small blue icons.

### Footer
Background #111827. 5-column layout for Quick Links, Brands, Categories, and Support. Include a social media icon row (Facebook, YouTube, X, Instagram) in brand-specific colored circles. Bottom bar separated by 1px gray-800 border with copyright text and 'Made in Bangladesh' credit.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Comparison Card — A utility card for choosing products side-by-side.
Design a card using #EBF2FF (Primary-bg). Place two search input dropdowns side-by-side with 10px text-gray-400 placeholders. Center a 40px circle with #0052CC background and 'VS' text in white bold. Include small 32px square icons for comparison features below the inputs, each with a caption in 9px text.

### Glassmorphism Metadata Badges — Floating floating status indicators used in the hero section.
Use a white background with 80% opacity and backdrop-filter: blur(4px). Border 1px solid #FFFFFF33. Add a small circular icon on the left with a specific color background (e.g., green-100 for price) and bold text on the right. Border-radius 12px. Box-shadow 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05).

### App Promotion Banner — A high-conversion section with app store links.
Gradient background from #0052CC to #3b82f6. Features a white QR code card (64px) and black app store buttons. Overlay a smartphone mockup on the right side that partially bleeds out of the container for a 3D effect.

style.description: The style is 'Modern Professional Tech' characterized by the Inter typeface (300 to 900 weights), a primary palette of Corporate Blue (#0052CC) and Bright Blue (#2684FF) against a sterile White and Light Gray background. It uses rounded corners (8px for buttons, 12px-16px for cards, 24px for hero elements) and subtle hover transforms (translateY(-2px)). Gradients are used sparingly for background depth (135deg #f0f4ff to #dbeafe) and section call-outs.
